steps.content: As usual, the Bureau is busy arresting Sinners, but the situation seems extra tricky today.
Everyone is busy with their own tasks, so much so that they don't even notice your approach.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Any news?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: That kid slipped away again... That little punk deliberately ran into the most bustling area and grabbed onto a few young people, crying out for mama.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Got everyone's attention at that intersection. We couldn't just take the kid away. If the Eastsiders knew a Sinner was there, it would cause panic.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Then just pretend you know where the mom is?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Tried that last time. When we passed by a shop, the kid asked to get off the car to look at the toys in the window, saying something like "I know I won't get another chance to see them." Our guys felt a bit sympathetic...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And you lost the target again? You had a whole team and you couldn't catch a single child?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: That kid is too cunning. Left a lot of the Homeless' signs at the wrong forks to distract us!
The guard hands Nightingale a badge with a familiar drawing on it.
Nightingale picks it up and examines it carefully. Then she sighs...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This one is also fake...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Sigh... The most we've managed so far is that we've put a tracker on that child.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: Adjutant, the kid has entered that building again.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: If the news from our guards in Eastside is true, the kid goes back there every once in a while. We suspect that is the kid's real home.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: We're gathering information about the property. It'll be available later.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: What's the plan, Adjutant? We have enough people. Should we break in?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's in Eastside. If we cause such a big trouble just to catch an A-Class Sinner, our future operations may face more restrictions...
Nightingale deliberates with the report in her hands.
Maybe there's something I can do.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief? I shouldn't have had to bother you with such a minor issue... I was negligent.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Although it's just an A-Class Sinner, the target is incredibly cunning. That kid seems aware that we wouldn't dare to escalate things in Eastside, giving us a lot of trouble.
Nightingale hands you the documents. The images captured by the surveillance camera seem familiar to you.
How did you find the child?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The sheriffs received a message from a civilian who had taken in a child who claimed to be a domestic abuse victim but then went missing in a few days. The civilian was worried something had happened to the child and contacted the sheriffs.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The sheriffs didn't take it seriously at first, but similar messages kept cropping up and more well-dressed young men and women were getting tricked. They finally had to take action.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: They indeed found a child on the street that matched the description, but the child ran off at the sight of the sheriffs. During the chase, they discovered that...
The child is a Sinner who can generate very fine threads with special power.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Do you know the target?
I almost forgot about this kid... Do you remember the incident at the toy factory?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sure... I've read your report. Was the target also involved in that...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Oh, I remembered... Oliver!
You nod and pass the documents to Nightingale.
You just mentioned that Oliver has been seeking help from well-dressed young men and women.
So we just need to match that requirement.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Carrying her doll, She cries with her face covered...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: She has no children of her own, only a doll...
In the dim basement, where even light can hardly penetrate, a soft tune echoes like a ghost's whispers.
Crawling on the ground, the voice is very light but serious. The singer must be thinking carefully about something.
Clack!
The sound of something snapping.
The singing stops. Someone is walking, but no one is talking.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oh dear! Cousin, you're too careless!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Why didn't you take good care of her, Auntie? Look, she's hurt herself again. It won't look good if it leaves a scar.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oliver hates ugly things. If you make a mistake and break my "toys", you're not a good kid anymore.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Since I was little, Auntie has always told me that bad kids who don't behave will be punished.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Now... You've misbehaved too. How should Oliver punish you?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: The investigation results from the Eastside Public Security Bureau have arrived.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: Chief and Adjutant Nightingale were right. Oliver does live in this house, but only returns every now and then and rarely stays for long.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: According to our investigation, Oliver lost both parents at a young age, and was adopted by aunt after that. This house is registered under Oliver's aunt and uncle.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: And they have a biological daughter, who is Oliver's cousin.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: But the three of them have gone missing for many years. They've stopped going to school or work.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What do their neighbors say?

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: This is the strangest part! The neighbors speak highly of Oliver and say they are a very harmonious family.

steps.speaker: Clerk
steps.content: They still see the family gathering around happily every night!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If they're indeed a loving family, Oliver wouldn't need to frequently go out and ask for strangers' help, right?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: There must be something more behind Oliver's relationship with the aunt's family... Chief, are you sure your plan will work?
Nightingale eyes your brand new outfit with a complicated expression.
Oliver only saw a gray rag doll in the toy factory. The kid won't recognize me like this.
I searched everywhere in the Bureau to put together this outfit. I'm sure it won't be a wasted trip for everyone.
You confirm the plan with all parties once more, and head toward the dilapidated house covered in cobwebs in front of you.
Knock, knock. The unhurried knocks on the door interrupt Oliver's pleasant reminiscence in the basement.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: How strange... Who would be visiting at this time...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Alright, I'll be right back! Remember to behave yourselves while I'm away. Don't ruin our little secret in the basement.
Knock, knock. The person knocks again. Oliver comes to the door, a bit annoyed.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Who is it? Is there something you need?
Oh, thank god, yes. Can you please help me?
I came here alone for a walk and got mugged... I gave them my phone and seized the chance to run away, but then I got lost around here.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: My family's not here. I'm alone...
Oliver fakes a helpless and innocent voice, seeming reluctant to open the door.
Cough, cough... I have some health issues that give me trouble breathing after running. Please, a cup of water and a place to sit will help me recover very soon.
Impatient, Oliver stands on tiptoes to look through the peephole in the door skeptically, but Oliver's expression brightens instantly at the sight of the visitor's outfit...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Wow, how glamorous... Oh, I mean, please come in, sir!
steps.female_content: Wow, how glamorous... Oh, I mean, please come in, miss!
